E Fund (HK) HKEX Tech 100 Index ETF (3456) Lists Today

The E Fund (HK) HKEX Tech 100 Index ETF, identified by the ticker 3456, has been listed today. This event marks its official availability for trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX). The listing provides investors with a new option to gain exposure to the technology sector represented by the HKEX Tech 100 Index.
